findings.description: Direct inspection of current V202 renders: crouch and sit expose both thighs through the front opening while the hem folds into angular flaps beneath the knees and the side/back skirt hangs behind. Prone tents the skirt above the hips and bunches it underneath. The front-lap geometry does not maintain a continuous hem or coverage in required poses.

Neutral front and three-quarter views show tightly crushed angular facets instead of separated broad pleat channels; the back reads as nearly plain with little visible pleat structure. The jacket torso/waist also has conspicuous crumpled faceting.

Both side silhouettes retain a front/side hem step and tapered tail rather than a smooth continuous hem. Gray patches are visible at both sleeve roots in front view and remain at viewer-right underarm with arms raised; sleeve-to-jacket overlap is uneven.

nextAction: Keep V202 rejected. For the next revision, redesign the front-lap attachment to preserve hem continuity while the knees flex; test an explicit skirt-support/collision response for prone rather than stretching the current row displacement. Retain broad pleat channels with controlled surface curvature on front and back, remove the side hem step/tail, and repair sleeve-root coverage. Rebuild and directly inspect the five views and six poses; do not advance release without the remaining fit, rig, Shape Key, Unity/VRChat, package, and release evidence.
